items.name: poland
items.description: Poland router. Use when topics cross domains.

items.name: poland-appeals-review
items.description: Administrative review. Use for a Polish refusal, delay, supplementation request, appeal, or missed procedural step.

items.name: poland-benefits-support
items.description: Benefits support. Use for Polish family benefits, social assistance, disability support, or Empatia routes.

items.name: poland-business
items.description: Business. Use when Polish registries matter.

items.name: poland-case-planning
items.description: Case planning. Use when Poland deadlines and multi-step procedures need a transient plan.

items.name: poland-citizenship-long-term
items.description: Long-term status. Use for Polish permanent residence, EU long-term resident status, or citizenship routes; not temporary residence.

items.name: poland-civic-participation
items.description: Civic participation and public information: route voting, voter registration, petitions, consultations, and information requests in Poland. Excludes political persuasion and eligibility claims.

items.name: poland-civil-life-events
items.description: Civil status and life events: route birth, marriage, name, death, funeral, and succession administration in Poland. Excludes residence status and personalized inheritance advice.

items.name: poland-consular-travel
items.description: Consular and travel-document services: route Polish consular help, passports, emergency documents, foreign-consulate handoffs, and cross-border travel administration. Excludes travel booking.

items.name: poland-consumer-banking
items.description: Consumer routes. Use when Polish complaints matter.

items.name: poland-digital-government
items.description: Digital government. Use for public Polish portal guidance and safe human-in-the-loop operation with caller-owned tools.

items.name: poland-disability-accessibility
items.description: Disability and accessibility services: route certification, PFRON support, workplace or education adjustments, care, and accessibility complaints. Excludes diagnosis and entitlement decisions.

items.name: poland-emergency-rights
items.description: Emergency rights. Use when danger or urgent escalation arises.

items.name: poland-employment-rights
items.description: Employment rights. Use for Polish contracts, pay, leave, hours, termination, workplace safety, or PIP complaints.

items.name: poland-employment-services
items.description: Public employment services: route jobseeker registration, labour offices, unemployment status or benefits, training, and employer services. Excludes work permits and workplace-rights disputes.

items.name: poland-eu-mobility
items.description: EU mobility. Use when Polish free-movement status matters.

items.name: poland-family-education
items.description: Family and education. Use for Polish childcare, school, university, or family administration; not benefits or residence status.

items.name: poland-foreign-documents
items.description: Foreign documents. Use for apostille, legalization, sworn translation, diploma recognition, or regulated-profession routing in Poland.

items.name: poland-healthcare
items.description: Healthcare. Use when NFZ or IKP matters.

items.name: poland-housing
items.description: Housing. Use when Polish tenancy matters.

items.name: poland-identity
items.description: Identity. Use when PESEL or meldunek matters.

items.name: poland-justice-legal-aid
items.description: Justice and legal-help routing: courts, legal aid, ombudsmen, victim support, enforcement, and procedural ownership in Poland. Excludes representation and personalized pleadings.

items.name: poland-local-services
items.description: Local services. Use when Polish office ownership varies.

items.name: poland-pensions-seniors
items.description: Pensions and senior services: route retirement, survivor benefits, cross-border contribution histories, care, and local senior support. Excludes benefit calculation or eligibility decisions.

items.name: poland-protection-referral
items.description: Protection referral. Use for asylum, international or temporary protection, unsafe return, or loss of protection in Poland.

items.name: poland-social-insurance
items.description: Social insurance. Use for Polish ZUS or eZUS registration, contributions, coverage records, or cross-border coordination.

items.name: poland-source-verification
items.description: Source checks. Use when Polish facts may be stale.

items.name: poland-stay-residence
items.description: Stay and residence. Use for Polish visas, legal stay, temporary residence, or residence cards; not protection, citizenship, or appeals.

items.name: poland-tax
items.description: Poland tax. Use for PIT, tax-residence orientation, tax identifiers, e-Tax Office, or official filing routes.

items.name: poland-transport-driving
items.description: Transport. Use when Polish licences or passenger rights matter.

items.name: poland-utilities-environment
items.description: Utilities and environment: route electricity, gas, heating, water, waste, provider disputes, and local environmental services in Poland. Excludes technical repair and contract negotiation.

items.name: poland-vehicles-road
items.description: Vehicles and road administration: route registration, ownership, inspections, compulsory insurance, tolls, parking, fines, and road incidents. Driving-licence matters stay separate.

items.name: poland-work-authorization
items.description: Work authorization. Use for permission to work in Poland, employer permits, declarations, notifications, or labour-market access.
